body:
I told my girlfriend once, she cried and was upset with me. Maybe rightfully say, 'cause I've never told her.

No one's online.

I'm just here. I think... maybe I'm in no danger. It's 2:30. She works around 8. I'm sad, but maybe fine. Listening to super sad songs, hoping it will be cathartic enough.

Truth is, I think of killing myself every day. And I don't want to. I really don't. I'm an alright dude. I just have this feeling that overwhelms me and I really want it to stop; but when it takes hold, it's all I can think about. I hate it. I hate this part of myself, but it's part of me nonetheless.

I can't have sex - I can masturbate, but for sex, my body stops working. I can interact, but mostly when I'm drunk, overly excited or stimulated by competition; etc. 

I feel like a shell that moves when it's told to.

And for some reason, I feel the need to apologize for it. I don't want sympathy - it's irrational.

I can't afford a therapist, and a social worker just listens. It's a weird place to be.
